title: Makar Sankranti 2027: Date, Punya Kaal and What It Is Called in Every State
seoTitle: Makar Sankranti 2027: Date, Punya Kaal, State Names
seoDescription: Makar Sankranti 2027 is on Friday 15 January; the Sun enters Makara at 9:14 pm on 14 January. Punya kaal timings, Lohri date and names in every state.
excerpt: Why the festival moves to 15 January in 2027, Delhi's punya kaal timings, the DoPT holiday position, and a state-by-state table of names, dishes and rituals from Lohri to Pongal.
